description: This file defines the LanguageService class for managing language entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and checking existence of languages, relying on a Data Access Object (LanguageDao).

classes.name: LanguageService
classes.description: Service class that provides business logic for managing language entities, including retrieval, persistence, deletion, and validation of language data.

methods.name: getLanguageDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of LanguageDao, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setLanguageDao
methods.description: Sets the LanguageDao instance for this service.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Saves a Language entity, either creating or updating it in the database.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of languages matching given search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Returns a list of languages based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple Language entities based on provided IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks if a language with the given name already exists, case-insensitive.
